extends Node
class_name MissionManager

signal objective_text_changed(text: String)

const TITLES := {
    "find_water": "ابحث عن ماء معدني",
    "find_fuel": "ابحث عن الإيصنص",
    "find_job": "دوّر على خدمة",
    "survive_blackout": "تحمّل انقطاع الكهرباء",
    "reach_port": "امشِ إلى ميناء حلق الوادي",
    "boat_stage": "اركب القارب"
}

func _ready() -> void:
    GameState.mission_changed.connect(_on_mission_changed)
    _emit_current()

func complete(id: String) -> void:
    if GameState.is_completed(id):
        return
    GameState.set_mission(id, "completed")
    match id:
        "find_water":
            GameState.set_mission("find_fuel", "active")
        "find_fuel":
            GameState.set_mission("find_job", "active")
        "find_job":
            GameState.set_mission("survive_blackout", "active")
        "survive_blackout":
            GameState.set_mission("reach_port", "active")
        "reach_port":
            GameState.set_mission("boat_stage", "active")
    _emit_current()

func _on_mission_changed(_id: String, _state: String) -> void:
    _emit_current()

func _emit_current() -> void:
    for id in ["find_water","find_fuel","find_job","survive_blackout","reach_port","boat_stage"]:
        if GameState.missions.get(id) == "active":
            objective_text_changed.emit(TITLES.get(id, id))
            return
    objective_text_changed.emit("المهام الرئيسية مكتملة")
